Comment: The combined findings are diagnostic of active, diffuse global lupus nephritis, ISN/RPS 2003 Class IV-G (A).

Microscopic Description: Sections of the lymph node show complete effacement of the normal architecture by a nodular infiltrate. The nodules are defined by broad bands of collagenous fibrosis. Within the nodules, there is a mixed inflammatory background composed of small lymphocytes, eosinophils, and histiocytes. Scattered throughout this background are large, atypical cells, including classic binucleated Reed-Sternberg cells and their mononuclear variants (Hodgkin cells). CD30: Positive
CD15: Positive
PAX5: Positive (dim)
CD45: Negative
CD20: Negative
CD3: Highlights the background T-cell population.

Comment: The morphologic findings in conjunction with the immunophenotype (CD30+, CD15+, PAX5+, CD45-) are diagnostic of Classical Hodgkin Lymphoma, Nodular Sclerosis subtype. Clinical correlation and appropriate oncologic management are recommended.

C4 2+ granular staining in mesangium and capillary loops.
Fibrinogen Negative.
Albaminine Negative.

Electron Microscopy Description: Electron microscopy confirms diffuse subendothelial and mesangial electron-dense deposits. Tubulointerstitial infiltrates are present within each tubular cell. There is approximately 50% podocyte foot process effacement.

Comment: The combined findings are diagnostic of active diffuse global lupus nephritis. SLE/RPS 2003 (Class IV-G (A)).
